bugs_injected.diagnosis: Cosine is scale-invariant (cos=1.000000 on 0.5x emb), hiding the bug until RMSNorm eps & KDA state diverge! Bit-exact fxmodel twin catches Row 0, Col 0 immediately.
Omitting -z*xsum collapses logits cos_min to 0.1719; do_selfmodel() localizes mismatch at Row 0 in 50 ms without running Yosys.

proxy_gap_violations.proxy_gap: 1. Statistical Wireload (5K_hvratio_1_1) vs. Post-Route RC Parasitics
proxy_gap_violations.rubber_stamp_error: Treats pre-layout topological delay (6.166 ns) as post-route signoff without placement, global/detailed routing, or SPEF RC extraction.

proxy_gap_violations.proxy_gap: 2. Blackboxed Memory Macros (39 msh_sram / msh_rom instances)
proxy_gap_violations.rubber_stamp_error: Ignores that msh_sram_bb.v has zero internal Liberty setup/hold/clk-to-Q timing arcs and zero physical routing blockage modeling.

proxy_gap_violations.proxy_gap: 3. Single-Corner Nominal Typical STA vs. Multi-Corner PVT & CTS
proxy_gap_violations.rubber_stamp_error: Evaluates only Nangate45 typical.lib with ideal 0-skew clock; omits SS setup corner, FF hold corner after CTS, and IR drop.
Lets the generator model (kimi-k3) hold 'commit' and 'reject' rights without independent human signoff or SHA-256 replay packets.
